# Issue 1: Create the SceneShift Xcode project

## Summary

Create the initial SwiftUI Xcode project for SceneShift and push it to the repository so app development can begin.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] SwiftUI app created
- [ ] SceneShift name used consistently
- [ ] Unit-test target exists
- [ ] UI-test target exists

- [ ] Deployment target documented
